about: Baselines for scripts/ci/durations.mjs, in seconds, measured from CI. A suite fails the nightly check when its newest green run took longer than its baseline plus the tolerance. Baselines may only fall: lower one when the check says a suite ran well under it. Browser shards are whole jobs (install, backend, build, tests); the unit and database suites are their steps in ci.yml. Plans/tests-worth-their-keep.md, Phase 10.
measured: 2026-10-13: the slowest green run of each suite in runs 38433989945 (ci.yml) and 38435568018 and 38437166271 (e2e.yml, dispatched). Two green runs of one shard differed by up to 25% (desktop 2/4: 263 s and 330 s): a browser job's time includes pulling the backend's images and installing a browser, which the runner's network decides. Hence the slowest, and 30%.
